name: Intertidal invertebrates
description: Rocky-shore invertebrates between the tides. Functional group dominated by barnacles, gastropods (snails, limpets) and bivalves - especially the mussel Mytilus edulis - pooled because the source's biomass estimate covered the intertidal community as a whole. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
